neighbours.label: a piece containing 'a' inside a proper name that starts with A/As/Az/Ar (Araiza, Azaña, Asa, ASSA, Arata)
fire: The tenor Francisco Araiza sang the role of Tamino.
Under Manuel Azaña the republic passed new laws.
The herbarium was founded with help from Asa Gray.
Yale locks are now made by the ASSA ABLOY group.
The Los Angeles museum was designed by Arata Isozaki.
The Spanish president Azaña went into exile in France.
Botanist Asa Gray wrote to Darwin about the orchids.
The company ASSA ABLOY bought the door maker last year.
quiet: The tenor Francisco Lopez sang the role of Tamino.
Under the new mayor the city passed new laws.
The herbarium was founded with help from the college.
Yale locks are now made by a Swedish group.
The Los Angeles museum was designed by a Japanese architect.
The Spanish president went into exile in France.
A young botanist wrote to Darwin about the orchids.
The company bought the door maker last year.

predictions: Fires on name pieces like 'Ara', 'za', 'a' in Araiza, Azaña, Asa Gray, ASSA ABLOY, Arata; quiet when the name is replaced by a common one or a role noun.
